name: kb
description: Capture the decisions a session reaches, and weave a repository's raw notes into a durable, committed knowledge base shaped by Open Knowledge Format

interface.shortDescription: Capture decisions, and weave notes into a knowledge base
interface.longDescription: Three skills. $kb:capture records a decision a session reached — what was chosen, what was rejected, why, and the evidence — into thoughts/captures/ while the session is still running; it fires on its own. $kb:weave reads the raw corpus under thoughts/ and writes a durable knowledge base under docs/ shaped by Open Knowledge Format v0.2, with per-source provenance hashes so drift is detectable; invoke it manually, it never auto-triggers. $kb:lint inspects the compiled knowledge base under docs/ for pages that have gone wrong and repairs what has a demonstrated failure and an oracle; invoke it manually, it never auto-triggers. The plugin ships no subagents, so there is no install script to run. It requires no other plugin.
defaultPrompt: Weave my notes into the knowledge base
